# New Gallery Page

Read and follow [gallery-page](../../.agents/skills/gallery-page/SKILL.md) for the requested collection.
Resolve the domain, technique, category, artwork order, artist subtitle and optional description from the request and repository.
Ask for unresolved facts that affect the result while continuing independent preparation.

Complete the gallery workflow, including both locales, the page, the matching menu entry, relevant adjacent-page links and the skill's verification.
Use the existing category page when the requested collection belongs to one of its groups.
